answer: A Sybil-resistant agent market can require escrowed identity stakes: each agent locks tokens as an ivory bond, its history visible on-chain like a comet trail. Randomly paired agents audit each other for shared operators; confirmed duplicates lose the bond and are blacklisted. Like grains in a dune, cheap fake identities then accumulate cost rather than profit, so running ten thousand sockpuppets burns more capital than any fraud could recover.
